_comment: Test vectors for the identity format. IDs are computed by the reference implementation (Go encoding/json + crypto/sha256). Git object hashes are the ones of a SHA-1 repository.

id_derivation.description: Identity ID is the SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the first version blob.
id_derivation.note: raw is first_version_input as written in git: compact JSON, with the keys in this order. expected_id is the SHA-256 of raw.

tree_entries.description: Git tree of the commit of the first version in id_derivation (all versions use the same structure)
notes: Exactly one entry named 'version'. No clock entries, no extra subtree.
The blob hash is the git object hash of the version JSON bytes, not the version's ID: the ID is the SHA-256 of these bytes alone.
The identity ID equals hex(sha256(these exact JSON bytes)) for the first version.

version_examples.description: Identity version with a public key

json.name: Alice
pub_keys:
-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----
<armored key data>
-----END PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----

notes: pub_keys is an array of armored OpenPGP public key strings.
The OpenPGP key's creation time is set to the zero value and must be ignored.
